subject.title: Memory MVP: define SQLite schema and canonical record model

question: Should durable memory move from Markdown files plus a SQLite search index to a plugin-owned typed SQLite record model for the Memory MVP, and what migration/provenance/review contract must v1 ship with?
rationale: This is a persistent session-state and data-model boundary across memory-core, migrations, provenance, review/forget flows, and the active memory plugin strategy; automation should not choose that contract.

options.title: Approve a plugin-owned SQLite MVP model
options.body: Define typed records, statuses, revision/provenance behavior, and a doctor/migration plan before implementation in the selected memory owner.

options.title: Keep Markdown canonical for now
options.body: Leave SQLite as retrieval/index storage and narrow or close this schema request until a durable record-store direction is approved.

options.title: Defer until memory convergence
options.body: Wait for the recommended active memory plugin path to be selected, then define the canonical schema inside that owner boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve a plugin-owned SQLite MVP model
recommendation.body: Define typed records, statuses, revision/provenance behavior, and a doctor/migration plan before implementation in the selected memory owner.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current-main history is on memory SQLite schema, migration, and index/state paths.
